I independently verified the 'fusion' artifact mentioned by the Router by looking at the junction between the left juvenile and the adult; it is indeed slightly soft/indistinct. I also verified the 'texture anomaly' on the right hand, which lacks the crispness of the face.

5. Harshness Bias: I avoided over-penalizing. Despite the Pose Auditor flagging 35% low-confidence keypoints, visually the monkeys look coherent. A score of 4.2 (rather than <3.0) correctly balances the technical keypoint uncertainty with the strong visual realism.

6. Atom Score Review: All atom scores are justified. The count is definitely 4. The color is definitely brown/brownish-grey. Monkeys are definitely present.

7. Upward Override Justification: I maintained the Router's positive verdicts for all checkpoints because visual evidence supports them (e.g., bare faces, forward eyes, ruffs are all visible). I did not override any negative findings; I accepted the 'Long non-prehensile tail' as not testable due to occlusion.
